title: Conditional probability from data
instructions: Read the question, work it out on paper, then show your work to the camera.
question_text: A dataset has 200 students. 80 took CS109, 60 took CS111, and 30 took both. If a student is selected at random from the dataset, what is P(CS109 | CS111)? Show your work.
rubric_items: Uses the definition P(A|B) = P(A and B) / P(B)
Correctly identifies counts for intersection and conditioning event from the prompt
Includes intermediate steps (not just the final number)
